Board Meeting Intimation for Corporate Announcement U/R 29(1)(A) Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 Read With SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015 Regarding Intimation Of Holding The 3/2026-27 Board Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On Friday, 13Th Day Of November, 2026

analysis.summary: Syncom Formulations (India) Limited submitted its 38th Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, reporting standalone total income of Rs. 51,753.92 lakhs and profit after tax of Rs. 7,600.80 lakhs. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.10 per equity share, representing 10% on the face value of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that volume growth in emerging and pharma-emerging markets continues to outpace mature markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume growth in emerging and "pharma-emerging" markets - including India, China, Latin America and Southeast Asia - continues to outpace mature markets such as North America, Western Europe and Japan, where per capita consumption is already high and incremental growth is comparatively moderate.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that total pharmaceutical spending globally remains on course to exceed US$ 2.3 Trillion by 2028, supported by a projected CAGR of 5-8%.
demand_outlook.quote: Total pharmaceutical spending remains on course to exceed US$ 2.3 Trillion by 2028, supported by a projected CAGR of 5–8%.

demand_outlook.claim: India's pharmaceutical market is projected to see medicine spending expected to reach US$ 38-42 Billion by 2028, with a CAGR of 7-10% from 2024 to 2028.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s pharmaceutical market is projected to see strong growth, with medicine spending expected to reach US$ 38-42 Billion by 2028, with a CAGR of 7–10% from 2024 to 2028.

demand_outlook.claim: India's real GDP growth for FY2024-25 is estimated at 6.5%.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s real GDP growth for FY2024-25 is estimated at 6.5%, reafrming its relative strength in a challenging global landscape.

margins_costs.claim: The pharmaceutical industry faces challenges from pricing regulations on drugs under the National List of Essential Medicines, impacting revenue potential and profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Regulatory Price Controls: Pharmaceutical industry continues to face challenges from pricing regulations on drugs brought under the National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM), which impacts revenue potential and profit margins.

margins_costs.claim: Global headline inflation is expected to reach 4.3% in 2025 and 3.6% in 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Global headline ination is expected to decline at a pace that is slightly slower than what was expected in January, reaching 4.3% in 2025 and 3.6% in 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.10 per equity share (10% on the face value of Rs. 1/- each) for the financial year 2025-26, subject to member approval.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of Rs. 0.10 per equity share, (i.e., 10% on the face value of Rs. 1/- each), for the financial year 2025-26, subject to the approval of the Members at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year 2024-25 in view to conserve resources.
capital_allocation.quote: In view to conserve resources, the Board has not recommended any dividend on Equity shares for the Financial Year 2024-25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Elevated global energy prices, geopolitical tensions, and dependence on China for APIs have kept supply chains under pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain vulnerabilities: Elevated global energy prices, continuing geopolitical tensions and India's continued 70-74% dependence on China for APIs and key raw materials have kept supply chains under pressure, intensifying input cost fluctuations and creating risks to procurement stability and manufacturing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Indian pharmaceutical industry faces potential disruption from proposed tariffs, including a 200% tariff on pharmaceutical imports by the US.
risks_headwinds.quote: Critically, the Indian pharmaceutical industry faces potential disruption from proposed tariffs, including a 200% tariff on pharmaceutical imports by the US, which is India's largest drug importer (accounting for nearly 33% of India's pharma exports in FY2024).

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry's continued 70-80% dependence on China for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) poses a strategic vulnerability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, the industry's continued 70-80% dependence on China for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) poses a strategic vulnerability despite government efforts to promote domestic API manufacturing.

management_commitments.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend payable to eligible members before Friday, 30th October, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Date of Payment before Friday, 30th October, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that the company's strategic focus will be on enhancing manufacturing capacities with world-class facilities.
management_commitments.quote: • Enhancing manufacturing capacities with world-class facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that the company will expand the nutraceutical and injectable portfolio to cater to evolving healthcare needs.
management_commitments.quote: • Expanding the nutraceutical and injectable portfolio to cater to evolving healthcare needs.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
